stage: M79 frozen: task-blind local affine charts
purpose: Test whether input-space covering produces reusable local computation and whether routing discontinuities limit fidelity; distinguish function geometry from native implementation.
training: Exactly the M77 4092 training positions, natural documents 0–31. No task or evaluation data in anchors or selection.
models: 32 random training points without replacement, NumPy default_rng seed7901
32 k-means centroids initialized from the same random points, exactly50 Lloyd steps
routing: Raw normalized-input Euclidean nearest anchor in float64; lowest-index ties. Empty clusters keep their previous centroids. Recompute final assignments. No whitening, K, seed, temperature or objective search.
chart: T_c(z)=F(c)+J(c)(z-c), F(z)=D[(Lz)*(Rz)]. Slopes/intercepts derived from native weights. The exact residual is F(z-c). Native Down bias added separately. No low-rank restriction.
theory: Quadratic remainder admits norm bound ||D|| ||L|| ||R|| ||z-c||^2; reducing nearest-anchor distance only reduces this upper bound, not necessarily the actual residual or downstream error. Nearest-chart routing can be discontinuous on equal-distance boundaries. Chart-switch term alone does not establish causal harm or rule out amplitude confounding.
preflight: Independent analytic/finite-difference toy Jacobians, exact remainder and routing-change decomposition; explicit continuous-native/discontinuous-chart counterexample. On real inputs verify routing, chart outputs and explicit affine matrices against native polynomial formulas before downstream use; float64 relative tolerance1e-8, float32 applied prediction relative tolerance1e-5. Override native forward with product guard. Freeze all anchors/state before evaluation.
evaluation: Same32 natural held-out docs and56taskpairs, all7families/14formats, all3background-change corners/source/final/identity, all ineligible and weak cases retained. Independently audit saved vectors and predictions. Fixed M78 affine and M76/M77 references. Record anchor distance, occupancy, chart switches and within-chart/routing decomposition; do not select models or examples by results.
cost: Report full chart storage and native-weight access. Full slopes for32charts are approximately42million coefficients, exceeding native MLP parameter count; no compression, speed, semantic-unit or manifold claim.
stop: Exactly one three-model comparison, then decide whether geometry improves causal fidelity enough to motivate a constrained learned representation. If not, return to targeted reusable subcomputation tests and broader causal supervision; no indefinite chart sweep.
